assumptions.E2_and_E3_literal: Observed prevention indicators do not exist in an actual RCT; these literal appendix statistics are oracle diagnostics, not usable trial power.
assumptions.E4: Fixed deployment-weighted V deciles and fixed stratum mean V; approximates V-weighted effect under within-stratum value homogeneity.
assumptions.clustering: DEFF applied by effective n=n/DEFF, equivalent to SE*sqrt(DEFF); no household data.
assumptions.contribution: 6 months * .60 * V; prevented churners exist only inside a simulation
assumptions.draws: Exact iid with replacement from selected non-test empirical distribution, represented by multinomial record counts
assumptions.missing_followup: WP1 primary grid has no unrequested follow-up losses; legacy reference check separately uses v2 10% allowance.
assumptions.observed_comparators: E2_observed and E3_observed use total observed 3.6*V*(1-future_churn); E4 uses observed stratum churn contrasts.
assumptions.tests: Positive-direction crossing of a two-sided 95% interval (z=1.96); nominal null directional size 2.5%, not a one-sided 5% test.

deviations: Literal E2/E3 oracle calculations retained exactly but prohibited for capacity conclusions. Observable E2/E3 comparators added to expose the appendix identification problem.

The v2 80k framing includes allocated startup, 10% follow-up loss and fixed calibration adjustment; WP1 separates variable-profit and any-effect nulls and fits trial OLS. Not comparable sample-size guarantees.
